title: Multi-Language Subtitles Demo
description: Shows subtitle localization with translations. Generates SRT sidecars in multiple languages alongside the native subtitle track.
script:
This video demonstrates our multi-language subtitle system. [Visual: language translation globe] [Transition: fade]
Subtitles are automatically generated in your chosen language. [Visual: subtitles on video screen] [Transition: slide]
Additional SRT sidecars can be produced for any language. [Visual: multiple language speech bubbles] [Transition: fade]
Spanish, French, Hindi, Tamil, and more are supported. [Visual: world map language regions] [Transition: slide]
Each translation is written as a standalone .srt file. [Visual: document files with translations] [Transition: fade]
Make your content accessible to a global audience. [Visual: global audience devices] [Transition: slide] [Grade: warm]
